name: WPCraftEngineer TemplateCraft – Store Template Builder
author: WP Craft Engineer

sections.description:
This is an independently developed addon and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially supported by Elementor or WooCommerce. Elementor and WooCommerce are trademarks of their respective owners.

Free WooCommerce template builder addon for Elementor. Build shop, category, archive and single product page templates without coding.

WPCraftEngineer TemplateCraft – Store Template Builder is a free Elementor addon that helps WordPress store owners build custom WooCommerce shop pages, product category archives, product tag archives and single product layouts with Elementor’s visual editor.

Create reusable WooCommerce templates, display product grids and customize supported Elementor elements without editing your theme’s WooCommerce PHP templates. Use Elementor’s visual controls to manage supported colors, typography, spacing and responsive layouts.

WooCommerce Shop Page Builder

Design a custom shop archive template using Elementor. Add product grids, sorting, result counts and pagination widgets to organize your WooCommerce catalogue.

WooCommerce Category and Product Archive Builder

Create Elementor templates for product category and product tag archives. Show category titles, descriptions, category images and product listings. Supported archive widgets provide pagination and products-per-page settings.

Single Product Page Builder

Create Elementor layouts for individual WooCommerce product pages. Available widgets include product title, images, price, SKU, stock status, short description, product meta, product tabs, ratings, related products, upsells and breadcrumbs.

Product Grids and Smart Archive Widgets

Build WooCommerce product listings with dedicated Products Grid, Archive Products and Smart Categories & Archive widgets. Control available display and pagination options from the widget settings.

Product Filtering and Enquiries

Use the WooCommerce Smart Filter Sidebar widget and Product Enquiry widget in supported layouts to help visitors explore your catalogue and contact you about products.

Elementor Visual Design Controls

Use Elementor’s editor to adjust supported layout, styling and responsive settings. The plugin works with Elementor’s template rendering rather than requiring you to hand-code a separate page template for each WooCommerce archive.

Key Features

  • WooCommerce shop page templates built with Elementor.
  • Product category, product tag and supported brand archive templates.
  • Custom WooCommerce single product page templates.
  • Product grids, archive product listings and category widgets.
  • Product sorting, result count and pagination widgets.
  • Smart category/archive and smart filter sidebar widgets.
  • Product enquiry widget for catalogue-focused stores.
  • Elementor styling and responsive layout controls.
  • Products-per-page and pagination options in supported archive widgets.
  • Reusable Woo Templates managed from the WordPress dashboard.

Requirements: An active installation of Elementor and WooCommerce. Some features depend on your theme and WooCommerce configuration.

Developer

Developed by wpcraftengineer: https://wpcraftengineer.com/

Video Tutorial

Watch the TemplateCraft video walkthrough to see the plugin in action:

Source Code

The plugin includes its human-readable PHP, JavaScript and CSS source files in the distributed ZIP. The JavaScript at assets/js/frontend.js is the maintained source file and can be edited directly; no external build process is required.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin ZIP via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin, or install it using the WordPress plugin directory when available.
  2. Activate Elementor and WooCommerce.
  3. Activate WPCraftEngineer TemplateCraft – Store Template Builder.
  4. Create a Woo Template from the WordPress dashboard and choose the supported template type and display target.
  5. Edit the template with Elementor, add Woo Builder widgets, and publish it.
  6. Visit the matching WooCommerce page to review the result. If archive links return 404 errors, resave Settings > Permalinks and clear the website cache.
sections.faq:
Can I customize WooCommerce shop pages with Elementor?

Yes. Create a Woo Template for the shop archive and edit its content using Elementor and the plugin’s WooCommerce widgets.

Can I build custom WooCommerce product category pages?

Yes. The plugin supports product category archive templates, including category-specific template targeting.

Does it support single product page layouts?

Yes. It includes widgets for common WooCommerce product information, images and related product content.

Can I change colors, fonts and spacing without writing CSS?

Supported Elementor elements can be styled using Elementor’s visual controls. Available controls vary by widget and Elementor version.

Does the plugin include product pagination?

Yes. Pagination widgets and pagination settings are available for supported WooCommerce archive product widgets.

Can I show a product enquiry form?

The plugin includes a Product Enquiry widget for supported product layouts.

Does it work on mobile devices?

You can configure supported responsive layout settings in Elementor. Always preview your templates at desktop, tablet and mobile widths.

Do I need Elementor and WooCommerce?

Yes. Both plugins are required.

Is this an official Elementor or WooCommerce plugin?

No. WPCraftEngineer TemplateCraft – Store Template Builder is an independent plugin that integrates with Elementor and WooCommerce.
